_comment: Default config is the faithful Olsen/Ivanov replication: per-feature heteroscedastic Gaussian output head (GaussianIvanovHead, min_sigma=1e-2, matches prob_utils.GaussianLoss in tigvarts/vaeac) plus prior->decoder MemoryLayer-style skip connections and the Ivanov latent-prior regulariser with (sigma_mu=1e4, sigma_sigma=1e-4). To run the legacy scalar-sigma baseline for ablation, set decoder_head='gaussian_scalar' and use_prior_memory=false. Total params at d_model=192, num_layers=4, ff_dim=768 with the Olsen config is ~5.76 M (vs 4.96 M for VelocityNet). mask_mode='benchmark' samples coalitions matched to the EC evaluator: uniform over {0,1}^K windows for temporal benchmarks, uniform over {0,1}^J joints for spatial.
